workarounds.symptom: An App created by setup github cannot run forge jobs: the branch-protection check needs Administration: read
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(github): judge branch protection by the branch's protected flag (#876). Target files: worker/src/comment-tables.mjs, worker/src/doctor.mjs, worker/src/forgejo-host.mjs. The worker's branch-protection check read `GET /repos/{o}/{r}/branches/{b}/protection`, which needs **Administration: read**. An App made by `pi-dispatch setup github` does not have that permission, so the read answered 403. The worker retried that as an infrastructure error, and every forge job failed with `worker-error`. (Ref: https://github.com/edgehero/pi-dispatch/pull/883)

workarounds.symptom: setup github --no-webhook is rejected by GitHub: the manifest's hook_attributes has no url
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(setup): an inactive hook still names a URL, so --no-webhook creates an App (#874). Target files: worker/src/github-app-setup.mjs, worker/test/github-app-setup.test.mjs, docs/polling.md. `pi-dispatch setup github --no-webhook` posted `hook_attributes: { active: false }`. GitHub refuses a manifest whose `hook_attributes` has no `url`, inactive or not ("url" wasn't supplied). So the flag the polling docs point to could not create an App. (Ref: https://github.com/edgehero/pi-dispatch/pull/875)

workarounds.symptom: doctor: project checks read PI_PROJECTS_FILE from the shell, not the deployment .env (false ✗ on secret bundles, size lines missing)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(doctor): judge the boot files the service reads, from the deployment .env (#859). Target files: worker/src/doctor-bundles.mjs, worker/src/doctor-model-proposals.mjs, worker/src/doctor.mjs. Doctor read the five boot-file keys (`PI_PROJECTS_FILE`, `PI_SCOPED_LIMITS_FILE`, `PI_PAUSE_WINDOWS_FILE`, `PI_ENVELOPE_FILE`, `PI_MODEL_ENDPOINTS_FILE`) from the deployment's `.env` for its BOOT_FILES lines only. Every other check that reads those files took the key from the shell, and the shell a service deployment is checked fro... (Ref: https://github.com/edgehero/pi-dispatch/pull/860)
